title: Naomi Baker Stars in 'Doing Life' on Netflix
seoTitle: Naomi Baker Stars in Netflix's 'Doing Life'
subtitle: The Dayton native lands a breakout role in Tyler Perry's drama
excerpt: Dayton native Naomi Baker plays Anika in Tyler Perry's new Netflix drama 'Doing Life', marking her biggest acting role to date.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Naomi Baker, a Dayton-born actress, has captured national attention by starring in the drama "Doing Life," recently released on the streaming platform Netflix. The premiere of the series prompted a surge in online searches as audiences look to learn more about the background of the performer now taking on one of the most significant roles of her career.

Who Naomi Baker is and how she landed the role

A graduate of Northmont High School and Ohio State University, Baker moved to Los Angeles four years ago. Prior to "Doing Life," she appeared in the series "All American: Homecoming." Her direct contact with writer-director Tyler Perry began after he watched a screener of Baker in the unreleased project "Hard Feelings" and texted her the script.

The character of Anika

In the series, Baker portrays Anika, a single mother who forms an unlikely bond with a former inmate. The role represents the biggest acting opportunity the actress has received since arriving in Los Angeles.

Family reaction and support for her talent

Naomi's parents, Mark and Tonya Baker, also from Dayton, shared that they always encouraged their daughter to pursue an artistic career. They recalled knowing the path would be competitive and that she would need to develop "thick skin" to handle rejection, but they always maintained faith in her potential. Both expressed pride in seeing their daughter reach a global project alongside a director they consider a "legend."

What the role means for Naomi's career

According to the actress herself, speaking directly with Tyler Perry was unexpected and memorable. She described the interaction as a moment of honor and gratitude, reinforcing the importance of believing in herself and her faith. Her family views the series as the first of many larger-scale projects.

Connection to Dayton and future outlook

Mark Baker, a well-known former basketball player in Dayton, emphasized that the family's roots in the city opened doors that once seemed unreachable. He believes Naomi's experience in achieving international visibility reflects the impact that hailing from Dayton can have on broadening professional horizons.

With information from Dayton Daily News.
